200 Assisted Housing and 38 Free Promotional Housing Units, Bas Mazagran
RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT

Located in Bas Mazagran, Mostaganem, this residential development comprises seven structural blocks containing 200 assisted housing units and 38 free promotional housing units, integrated with ground-floor commercial premises.

The project optimizes vertical density through its structural massing and facade articulation, incorporating dedicated pedestrian access and roads and utility networks (VRD) to support the new residential footprint.

The architectural layout distributes 238 apartments across seven concrete structural blocks, designed with a configuration of four apartments per landing to optimize internal circulation and structural efficiency.

The construction program is advancing through the final trades phase, focusing on secondary architectural works, facade masonry infill, internal technical installations, and the completion of roads and utility networks (VRD).
OFFICE DE PROMOTION ET DE GESTION IMMOBILIÈRE (OPGI)

What is 200 Assisted Housing and 38 Free Promotional Housing Units?
The project consists of 200 assisted housing units and 38 free promotional housing units, distributed across seven structural blocks with ground-floor commercial premises.
What is the structural configuration of the blocks?
The project encompasses the spatial and structural execution of 238 distinct apartments across seven blocks, maintaining a highly efficient spatial ratio of four residences per landing.
Who is the client for this residential development?
The project is being delivered for the Office de Promotion et de Gestion Immobilière (OPGI) to address regional housing requirements.
What is the current status of the construction works?
The project is currently in progress, with works focusing on secondary architectural trades, facade masonry, and the installation of roads and utility networks (VRD).
